layouts.name: Hanoi
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The independently mapped July 2020 full Hanoi Street Circuit retains both northern sweeping sections, the long eastern straight and southern hairpin, excluding the separate pit lane. Formula 1 documents completion of the 23-turn hybrid circuit in February 2020 and its 5.613 km configuration. The 5618.6 m source route matches the catalogue branch identity and remains unscaled against its 5622 m timing scalar. This is a historical built-course draft; the identification reference announcing a planned race does not establish that the race occurred. Temporary barrier and carriageway alignment remain provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 5618.6 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
